message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "fr_dns_decode_proto", "line": 580, "var": "data", "code": "packet_ctx->packet = data;", "note": "Attacker-controlled DNS packet buffer is stored as the packet start in the decode context."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "fr_dns_decode_proto", "line": 583, "var": "packet_ctx->lb", "code": "packet_ctx->lb = fr_dns_labels_init(packet_ctx, data, 256);", "note": "Label tracking structure initialized with packet start; blocks[0] covers offsets 12..12."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "fr_dns_decode", "line": 459, "var": "slen", "code": "slen = fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_packet, packet, DNS_HDR_LEN, true, packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL);", "note": "12-byte DNS header is decoded; QDCOUNT=1 is read from bytes 4-5."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "fr_dns_decode", "line": 468, "var": "p", "code": "slen = decode_record(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_question, p, end - p, packet_ctx, packet + 4);", "note": "Question section decode begins at p = packet+12 with 1 remaining byte; QDCOUNT=1 drives one iteration."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "decode_record", "line": 407, "var": "slen", "code": "slen = fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr, p, end - p, true, packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL);", "note": "Question struct decode called with data=p (the 0xC0 byte) and data_len=1."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/lib/util/struct.c", "function": "fr_struct_from_network", "line": 232, "var": "child_length", "code": "if (!child_length) child_length = (end - p);", "note": "qname has variable length (flags.length=0), so child_length becomes the full remaining 1 byte."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/lib/util/struct.c", "function": "fr_struct_from_network", "line": 244, "var": "slen", "code": "slen = decode_value(child_ctx, &child_cursor, fr_dict_by_da(child), child, p, child_length, decode_ctx);", "note": "decode_value_trampoline is invoked for the qname field with data pointing at the 0xC0 byte."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "decode_value_trampoline", "line": 91, "var": "parent", "code": "return decode_dns_labels(ctx, cursor, dict, parent, data, data_len, decode_ctx);", "note": "qname is FR_TYPE_STRING with dns_label subtype, so decode_dns_labels is called with data_len=1."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/protocols/dns/decode.c", "function": "decode_dns_labels", "line": 354, "var": "buf_len", "code": "slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb);", "note": "buf_len is computed as data + data_len - packet = 13, so end = buf + buf_len extends 12 bytes past the actual 13-byte heap buffer."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/lib/util/dns.c", "function": "fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length", "line": 920, "var": "p", "code": "p = current = start;", "note": "p starts at the 0xC0 compression-pointer byte, which is the last byte of the 13-byte heap buffer."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "src/lib/util/dns.c", "function": "fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length", "line": 970, "var": "p", "code": "if ((p + 2) > end) {", "note": "Bounds check compares against inflated end (packet+25) instead of the real buffer end (packet+13), so p+2=packet+14 passes the check."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "src/lib/util/dns.c", "function": "fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length", "line": 978, "var": "offset", "code": "offset = p[1];", "note": "READ of p[1] at packet+13 is 1 byte past the end of the 13-byte heap buffer, causing heap-buffer-overflow READ 1."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now let me write the candidate trace. The trace should describe the path from attacker-controlled input through propagation and root cause to the memory-safety sink.

The path is:
1. Attacker-controlled DNS packet input to `fr_dns_decode_proto`
2. `packet_ctx->packet` set to the input buffer
3. `fr_dns_decode` decodes the header
4. `decode_record` for questions with QDCOUNT=1
5. `fr_struct_from_network` for the question struct
6. `decode_value_trampoline` → `decode_dns_labels` for qname
7. `fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length` with `buf_len = data + data_len - packet` which extends `end` beyond the actual buffer
8. The compression pointer check `(p + 2) > end` passes because `end` is too large
9. `offset = p[1]` reads OOB
